cast: Lily (girl, 9), her brother Tom (6), Mum, Dad, Grandma, Grandpa, Lily's classmate Mia, cousin Sam (10) and the puppy Max. Core words: Fun and Shows.

words.sz: 我的朋友们有一个乐队。
words.scene: Three children playing music in a garage, one on drums, one on guitar, one singing into a microphone.
more: 这个乐队演奏大声的音乐。
Sam plays the drums in a band.

words.scene: A big striped tent with a clown juggling balls in front of it, children watching happily.
more: 马戏团里有有趣的小丑。
Lily saw lions at the circus.
Lily 在马戏团看到了狮子。

words.scene: A cinema screen showing a man slipping on a banana peel, the audience laughing.
Dad wearing an apron, stirring a pot on the stove while Tom watches curiously.
more: We help Mum with the cooking.

words.scene: Lily in a blue dress jumping and waving her arms gracefully in the living room.
more: The music is good for dancing.

words.scene: A boy standing on the edge of a high diving board above a blue swimming pool, looking down.
more: She has a diving lesson today.

words.scene: Children running in a race on the school field, parents watching and clapping.
more: This is a big family event.
这是一个重要的家庭活动。
We plan for the next event.
我们为下一个活动做计划。

words.scene: A man lifting a small barbell in a room with mirrors and exercise mats.
more: We play games in the gym.
我们在体育馆里做游戏。

words.scene: Lily and Tom in woolly hats and gloves, holding hands and ice skating on a frozen outdoor rink, the blades of their ice skates clear on the white ice, snowy trees around.
An old man relaxing in an armchair with headphones on, a saxophone player on a stage in the background.
A boy wearing a cap backwards, holding a microphone and moving his hands to the beat.
more: 他们随着说唱音乐跳舞。

words.scene: Lily sitting comfortably in a beanbag chair with an open book, sunlight coming through the window.
more: Tom 的阅读越来越好了。

words.scene: A group of children in white shirts standing in a row, mouths open, holding songbooks.
A boy in a helmet riding a skateboard on a smooth concrete path, trees in the background.
Children wearing roller skates with knee pads, holding hands and moving in a circle on the pavement.
A family standing in front of a famous landmark, taking photos with a camera and phones.
A surfer standing on a board riding a big blue wave in the ocean, wearing a wetsuit.
more: Uncle Ben goes surfing in summer.

words.scene: A boy running on a track in the park, wearing sports clothes and a stopwatch around his neck, looking determined.
more: We need more training for the match.
我们需要为比赛做更多训练。

words.scene: Two teams in different coloured shirts playing football on a green field, a referee blowing a whistle.
more: The tennis match starts at two o'clock.

words.en: Lily got a high score in maths.
words.sz: Lily 在数学课上得了高分。
words.scene: A girl smiling happily holding a test paper with a big red tick mark on it, sitting at a school desk.
more: The final score was two to one.

words.en: The actors are on the stage.
words.scene: A wide wooden stage with red curtains, two children in costumes standing under a bright spotlight.
more: We practise plays on the school stage.
我们在学校舞台上排练戏剧。
Look at the girl dancing on the stage.
看那个在舞台上跳舞的女孩。

words.sz: 妈妈唱着一首快乐的曲子。
words.scene: A woman singing while playing the piano, musical notes floating in the air around her.
more: 我知道这首老歌的调子。
他唱着一首有趣的曲子。

words.en: Tom takes a selfie with Max.
words.sz: Tom 和 Max 拍了一张自拍。
words.scene: A young boy holding a phone high up, smiling big, with a cute puppy looking at the camera next to him.
Children in costumes performing on a stage, parents clapping happily in the audience seats.
more: Lily practised for her piano performance.
Lily 为钢琴演出做了练习。
我们看了一场舞蹈表演。
We saw a funny musical film.
我们看了一部有趣的音乐电影。

words.en: We watched a movie last night.
words.sz: 我们昨晚看了一部电影。
words.scene: A family sitting on a sofa eating popcorn, looking at a large screen showing a cartoon lion.
more: Let's go to the cinema for a movie.
我们去电影院看电影吧。

words.scene: A girl holding up a colourful drawing of a house and trees, smiling proudly at the viewer.
more: The museum has many old paintings.
博物馆里有很多古老的画作。
He is good at painting flowers.

words.scene: Inside a bright room with white walls, several framed pictures hanging, people walking slowly to look at them.
more: There are no photos in the gallery.
The gallery is quiet and clean.

words.en: Dad has a surprise for us.
words.sz: 爸爸给我们准备了一个惊喜。
words.scene: A man holding a wrapped gift box with a bow behind his back, children looking curious and happy.
more: Happy birthday! It's a big surprise.
生日快乐！这是一个大惊喜。
Grandma gave us a nice surprise.
奶奶给了我们一个美好的惊喜。

words.sz: 妈妈给了 Tom 一个吻。
words.scene: A mother leaning over a sleeping child in bed, gently kissing his forehead, soft moonlight coming through the window.
more: She gave me a kiss goodbye.
她给了我一个告别的吻。

words.sz: 这部动作电影很快节奏。
words.scene: A family in cinema seats watching an exciting action film on the big screen: a red sports car flying through the air over a river between two hills; Tom on the edge of his seat holding popcorn.

words.sz: 阅读是我最喜欢的活动。
words.scene: A girl sitting comfortably in an armchair reading a book, a cat sleeping on the rug beside her.
more: 游泳是一项有趣的活动。

words.en: Lily wants to take part in the race.
words.scene: A girl wearing a sports bib number, standing at the starting line with other runners, looking ready and confident.
more: Can I take part in the club?
我可以参加这个俱乐部吗？
They took part in the school play.
他们参加了学校的话剧。

words.en: Dad works out in the park every morning.
words.sz: 爸爸每天早上在公园锻炼。
words.scene: A man doing push-ups on the grass in a park, wearing sportswear, looking fit and healthy.
more: Mum likes to work out at the gym.
妈妈喜欢在健身房锻炼。
Uncle Ben works out with Sam.
Ben 叔叔和 Sam 一起锻炼。
